MYFIRSTCHARACTER-CASTER_STARTING_RELIC.t: The Sacred Sword Wielder of the Inner Sea
MYFIRSTCHARACTER-CASTER_STARTING_RELIC.d:
Switch between Sword Form and Summer Star, and unleash powerful effects by building NP.
Sword Form: On entering, gain 20 NP and 1 Weak. In this form, damage from Vulnerable enemies is reduced to 70%.
Summer Star: On entering, gain 2 Strength and 2 Vulnerable. In this form, playing a card applies 1 Vulnerable to all enemies.
NP: Maximum 300. When NP reaches 100 or more, add an NP card to your hand. Playing an NP card spends 100 NP. Afterwards, if NP is still 100 or more, add another NP card to your hand.

Switch between Sword Form and Summer Star, and unleash powerful effects by building NP.
Sword Form: On entering, gain 30 NP and 1 Weak. In this form, damage from Vulnerable enemies is reduced to 70%.
Summer Star: On entering, gain 4 Strength and 1 Vulnerable. In this form, playing a card applies 1 Vulnerable to all enemies.
NP: Maximum 300. When NP reaches 100 or more, add an NP card to your hand. Playing an NP card spends 100 NP. Afterwards, if NP is still 100 or more, add another NP card to your hand.
Give people stars, give stars dreams.
